final touch.zh: 最後的潤飾、收尾的一筆
ai: She added the final touch to the painting with a thin line of gold.
她用一道細細的金線為這幅畫畫上最後一筆。
A few flowers on the table were the final touch to the decoration.
桌上的幾朵花是這個布置的最後點綴。
I'm just putting the final touch on my presentation slides.
我正在為簡報做最後的修飾。

finishing touch.zh: 最後的潤飾、收尾的一筆
ai: The scarf was the finishing touch to her outfit.
這條圍巾為她的穿搭畫下完美句點。
The chef put the finishing touch on the cake with fresh strawberries.
主廚用新鮮草莓為蛋糕做最後的裝飾。
We still need a finishing touch to make the room feel warm.
我們還需要一點收尾的巧思，讓房間更有溫度。
Don't spill the beans about the surprise party.
別把驚喜派對的事說溜嘴。
My little brother spilled the beans about my birthday gift.
我弟弟把我生日禮物的事說了出來。
Who spilled the beans to the boss about our plan?
是誰向老闆洩漏了我們的計畫？
Studying abroad can cost an arm and a leg.
出國留學可能非常花錢。
That new phone cost an arm and a leg.
那支新手機貴得嚇人。
A wedding in this city costs an arm and a leg.
在這個城市辦婚禮要花一大筆錢。
Saving money now will help you in the long run.
現在存錢，長遠來看對你有幫助。
Cheap shoes can cost more in the long run.
便宜的鞋子長遠來看可能更花錢。
Exercise is good for your health in the long run.
運動長期下來對健康有益。
I like the job; on the other hand, the pay is low.
我喜歡這份工作，但另一方面，薪水很低。
The hotel is cheap. On the other hand, it is far from the station.
這間旅館很便宜，但另一方面，離車站很遠。
Cars are fast; on the other hand, bikes are better for the environment.
汽車很快，但另一方面，腳踏車對環境比較好。
We visit our grandparents from time to time.
我們偶爾會去探望祖父母。
He still calls me from time to time.
他偶爾還是會打電話給我。
From time to time, the bus is late in the rain.
下雨時公車偶爾會誤點。
You hit the nail on the head when you said we need more time.
你說我們需要更多時間，真是一針見血。
Her comment hit the nail on the head.
她的評論正中要害。
He hit the nail on the head about why the team lost.
他點出了球隊輸球的真正原因。
He cooks dinner only once in a blue moon.
他很難得才煮一次晚餐。
We see snow here once in a blue moon.
這裡很少下雪。
My sister writes letters once in a blue moon.
我姊姊難得才寫一次信。
He was late, and to add insult to injury, he forgot my gift.
他遲到了，而且更過分的是還忘了我的禮物。
The rain ruined our trip, and the flight delay added insult to injury.
雨毀了我們的旅行，班機延誤更是雪上加霜。
They fired him and, to add insult to injury, took his car.
他們開除了他，還雪上加霜地收走他的車。
The company cut corners to save money.
那間公司為了省錢而偷工減料。
Don't cut corners when you build a bridge.
蓋橋時不能偷工減料。
He never cuts corners on his homework.
他寫作業從不偷懶走捷徑。
She got cold feet right before the wedding.
她在婚禮前夕突然打了退堂鼓。
I almost got cold feet before the interview.
面試前我差點臨陣退縮。
Many investors get cold feet when the market falls.
市場下跌時，許多投資人會裹足不前。
Our waiter went the extra mile to make my birthday special.
我們的服務生特別用心讓我的生日更難忘。
She always goes the extra mile for her clients.
她總是為客戶多付出一分心力。
If you go the extra mile, people will notice.
如果你多付出一點，大家都會看見。
We got to the station in the nick of time.
我們在最後一刻趕到車站。
The doctor arrived in the nick of time.
醫生及時趕到。
He saved the file in the nick of time before the power went out.
他在停電前的最後一刻存好了檔案。
Let's meet first to make sure we are on the same page.
我們先開個會，確認大家想法一致。
The two teams are not on the same page about the schedule.
兩個團隊對時程的看法不一致。
Are we all on the same page now?
現在大家都達成共識了嗎？
I don't have a plan for tonight; let's play it by ear.
我今晚沒有計畫，到時再看吧。
We'll play it by ear and see how the weather is.
我們看天氣再決定吧。
She prefers to play it by ear when she travels.
她旅行時喜歡隨興、看情況而定。
My boss and I don't always see eye to eye.
我和老闆的看法不見得總是一致。
The two brothers rarely see eye to eye on money.
這兩兄弟在金錢上很少意見一致。
We finally saw eye to eye on the price.
我們終於在價錢上達成共識。
Don't take it for granted that people will help you.
不要認為別人幫你是理所當然的。
We take it for granted that the water is clean.
我們把乾淨的水視為理所當然。
He took it for granted that she would come.
他想當然爾地認為她會來。
These complaints are only the tip of the iceberg.
這些抱怨只是冰山一角。
The error we found is just the tip of the iceberg.
我們發現的錯誤只是冰山一角。
Those figures are the tip of the iceberg.
那些數字不過是冰山一角。
After three failed tries, he threw in the towel.
嘗試三次都失敗後，他放棄了。
Don't throw in the towel yet; you can still win.
先別認輸，你還有機會贏。
The team threw in the towel at halftime.
那支球隊在中場休息時就認輸了。
You can stay with us for the time being.
你暫時可以住在我們這裡。
For the time being, the store is closed.
這間店目前暫停營業。
This plan is fine for the time being.
這個計畫目前這樣就可以了。
As a matter of fact, I have been there twice.
事實上，我去過那裡兩次。
I'm not tired. As a matter of fact, I feel great.
我不累，事實上我感覺很棒。
As a matter of fact, he is my cousin.
事實上，他是我的表哥。
All of a sudden, the lights went out.
燈突然全滅了。
The sky got dark all of a sudden.
天空忽然暗了下來。
All of a sudden, she began to laugh.
她突然笑了起來。
I eat fast food every now and then.
我偶爾會吃速食。
We go hiking every now and then.
我們時不時會去健行。
Every now and then, he sends me a funny photo.
他偶爾會傳搞笑照片給我。
In a nutshell, we need more money.
簡單來說，我們需要更多資金。
Here is the story in a nutshell.
這是故事的簡要說明。
To put it in a nutshell, the plan failed.
簡而言之，計畫失敗了。
To make a long story short, we missed the flight.
長話短說，我們錯過了班機。
To make a long story short, he got the job.
長話短說，他得到了那份工作。
To make a long story short, I said no.
長話短說，我拒絕了。
Needless to say, we were very happy.
不用說，我們非常開心。
Needless to say, the exam was hard.
不用說，考試很難。
Needless to say, he apologized.
當然，他道歉了。
You need to make up your mind soon.
你得快點做決定。
I can't make up your mind for you.
我沒辦法替你做決定。
Have you made up your mind yet?
你決定好了嗎？
She works two jobs to make ends meet.
她打兩份工才勉強維持生活。
It is hard to make ends meet in a big city.
在大城市要收支平衡很不容易。
They barely make ends meet each month.
他們每個月都勉強打平開銷。
Let's make the most of our free time.
我們好好利用空閒時間吧。
He made the most of his chance to study abroad.
他充分把握出國讀書的機會。
Make the most of every day.
把握每一天。
